plainText:
The following is a list of all of the English language home video releases of the special season of , Pokémon Chronicles, in and ( ).

==Super Wallets==
 
 (now known as Beyond Home Entertainment) began releasing Super Wallets to celebrate the . Some Super Wallets also included one or more bonus discs containing episodes of Pokémon Chronicles (which was designed to resemble a Premier Ball).

===Pokémon Super Wallets with Chronicles episodes===
 

==Pokémon Chronicles disc set==
 
 (now known as Beyond Home Entertainment) released the Pokémon Chronicles disc set on December 1, 2011. It contains three discs with all 22 episodes of Pokémon Chronicles across them combined. Its catalogue number is DBX13845. Its discs are designed to resemble a Premier Ball.
